children: Redwood Trust completed a $205 million Rule 144A offering of 7.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2030 and entered into an Indenture with Wilmington Trust to govern the securities. The Purchase Agreement, signed September 10, 2026, included a $20 million option that was fully exercised at settlement on September 15, 2026. The notes pay semi-annual interest, carry an initial conversion rate of 204.0608 shares per $1,000 (about $4.90 per share), and mature on September 15, 2030. Proceeds are intended to bolster liquidity and support refinancing of outstanding 2027 convertible notes.
